description: EDGE-E4 in the spec says a malformed roi.jsonl line SHALL be skipped during scan and LOGGED to state/reconciler-last-run.json.errors — i.e., preserved for observability, not silently deleted. But reconciler.py line 135-141 parses roi.jsonl and drops malformed lines from `roi_rows`, and then line 211-213 rewrites roi.jsonl using ONLY `roi_rows` (json.dumps of successfully-parsed rows). Consequences: any malformed roi row on disk is silently DELETED from the file whenever any valid row exists. This is data loss on a live-money ledger (roi.jsonl feeds feature (c) dormant-gate logic which depends on roi_jpy_realized > 0 in the last 90 days). There is also no code path that writes the errors field to reconciler-last-run.json.errors. No test covers EDGE-E4 (no test in test_reconciler.py named after malformed roi).
